facts: title plans identify the general extent of registered land
all title plans show general boundaries unless a boundary is determined under section 60
urban title plans are usually 1:1250 and rural plans usually 1:2500
red edging normally follows the inside of physical or plotted boundary lines
dimensions shown on title plans do not make a general boundary exact
new files are published on the first Sunday of every month
polygons are downloadable by local authority
the dataset shows indicative extent and position of registered freehold properties
INSPIRE is a subset of the Index Polygons database
a polygon crossing a local-authority boundary appears in both local-authority files

promotion_rule: INSPIRE/title-plan geometry is candidate measurement geometry only and is never represented as an exact legal boundary unless determined-boundary evidence exists.
